reconciliationSummary.parityStatus: 100% Accounted (14,508 matched variants + 8 documented exclusions = 14,516 total snapshot records)

exclusionRulesApplied.description: Records containing exclusively promotional, ad-aggregator, or unverified download links (e.g. 4khdhub.one, hdhub4u.ec, greenmotors.club, whatsapp.com) are strictly quarantined from entering the canonical catalog until verified storage CDN endpoints are confirmed.
Under PRAFLIX web series completeness rules, individual episodes or partial seasons (e.g. '[EP-04 Added]') are strictly omitted until the full series or full season release is available.
Listing items that represent promotional studio trailers rather than full movie streams/downloads are excluded from media catalog variants.
Secondary duplicate cam-rip audio listings of existing pristine canonical titles are quarantined to prevent catalog audio degradation.
Secondary regional audio dub line variants that duplicate existing canonical titles without clean multi-audio streams are quarantined.
Listings with conflicting metadata (e.g. year mismatch between title and URL slug) and unverified link destinations are quarantined.
